listings.name: Major Dysfunction of a Joint
required_evidence: Imaging (X-ray, MRI) showing joint space narrowing, bony destruction, or ankylosis
Documentation of inability to walk effectively or perform fine/gross movements
Medical records showing involvement of one major peripheral weight-bearing joint
Treatment records including surgical history if applicable
listings.description: Major dysfunction of a joint due to any cause, with history of joint pain and stiffness, resulting in inability to ambulate effectively or perform fine and gross movements effectively.

listings.name: Disorders of the Spine
required_evidence: MRI or CT showing nerve root compression, spinal arachnoiditis, or lumbar spinal stenosis
Medical records documenting ongoing pain and limited range of motion
Evidence of neurological deficits (numbness, weakness, reflex changes)
Treatment history showing condition persists despite treatment
listings.description: Disorders of the spine resulting in compromise of a nerve root or the spinal cord, with neuro-anatomic distribution of pain, limitation of motion, and motor loss.

listings.name: Soft Tissue Injury
required_evidence: Medical documentation of the injury and surgical treatment
Evidence of inability to ambulate effectively or perform fine/gross movements
Documented functional limitations persisting despite treatment
listings.description: Soft tissue injury of an upper or lower extremity, trunk, or face and head, requiring surgical management within 12 months of onset.

listings.name: Amputation (due to any cause)
required_evidence: Medical documentation of the amputation surgery or physical impairment
Evidence of inability to walk effectively (e.g. needing a walker, crutches, or bilateral canes) OR inability to perform fine/gross movements with an upper extremity
Prosthetic treatment records and evaluation of the effectiveness of the prosthetic device
Treatment history showing limitations persist despite rehabilitation
listings.description: Amputation of one or both lower extremities, or one or both upper extremities, resulting in significant difficulty walking or performing manual tasks.

listings.name: Non-healing Fracture of Femur, Tibia, Pelvis
required_evidence: X-ray or imaging showing lack of solid union
Documentation of inability to walk effectively without assistance
Medical records showing non-healing persists for at least 12 months from onset
listings.description: Non-healing fracture of the femur, tibia, pelvis, or one or more of the tarsal bones, with solid union not evident and resulting in inability to ambulate effectively.

listings.name: Non-healing Fracture of Upper Extremity
required_evidence: Imaging showing lack of solid union
Documentation of inability to perform fine/gross motor movements with both hands
Medical records showing non-healing persists for at least 12 months from onset
listings.description: Non-healing fracture of an upper extremity, with solid union not evident and resulting in inability to perform fine and gross movements effectively.

listings.name: Hearing Loss
required_evidence: Audiometric testing showing hearing loss at listing-level thresholds
Word recognition score of 40% or less in the better ear
OR cochlear implant (considered disabled for 1 year post-implant)
ENT or audiology treatment records
listings.description: Hearing loss not treated with cochlear implantation, with average air conduction hearing thresholds and word recognition scores at listing levels.

listings.name: Vestibular/Labyrinthine Disorders
required_evidence: Medical history of frequent attacks of vertigo, tinnitus, and progressive hearing loss
Vestibular function testing (caloric or other testing)
Audiometric testing documenting hearing loss
listings.description: Disturbance of vestibular-labyrinthine function characterized by frequent attacks of vertigo, tinnitus, and progressive loss of hearing.

listings.name: Loss of Speech
required_evidence: Medical documentation of organic cause of speech loss
Evidence of inability to produce speech that can be heard, understood, or sustained
Speech therapy and specialist evaluations
listings.description: Loss of the ability to produce speech by any means that can be heard, understood, and sustained, due to organic pathology.

listings.name: Vision Loss
required_evidence: Visual acuity testing showing remaining vision of 20/200 or less in the better eye with best correction
OR visual field testing showing contraction to 20 degrees or less in the better eye
Ophthalmology treatment records
Documentation that vision loss persists despite treatment
listings.description: Loss of visual acuity or visual field loss resulting in remaining vision of 20/200 or less in the better eye, or contraction of the visual field to 20 degrees or less.

listings.name: Chronic Respiratory Disorders (COPD)
required_evidence: Spirometry (pulmonary function testing) showing FEV1 at or below listing-level values
OR arterial blood gas (ABG) showing chronic impairment
Documentation of need for supplemental oxygen if applicable
Pulmonologist treatment records
listings.description: Chronic respiratory disorders with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, chronic restrictive ventilatory disease, or chronic impairment of gas exchange.

listings.name: Asthma
required_evidence: Spirometry showing FEV1 values at listing level, or evidence of asthma attacks requiring emergency treatment
Documentation of at least 3 exacerbations in 12 months requiring 48+ hours of hospitalization
Medical records showing compliance with prescribed treatment
Emergency room and hospitalization records
listings.description: Asthma with FEV1 at listing level, or exacerbations despite adherence to prescribed treatment, requiring intensive treatment such as hospitalization.

listings.name: Cystic Fibrosis
required_evidence: Spirometry showing FEV1 at or below listing-level values
OR documentation of frequent respiratory complications (exacerbations, collapsed lung) requiring hospitalization
Genetic or sweat chloride test results confirming diagnosis
listings.description: Cystic fibrosis characterized by chronic pulmonary or gastrointestinal manifestations, evaluated by spirometry or frequency of hospitalizations.

listings.name: Bronchiectasis
required_evidence: Imaging (CT scan) showing bronchiectasis
Documentation of exacerbations requiring hospitalization at least 3 times in a 12-month period
Spirometry testing results
listings.description: Bronchiectasis characterized by permanent dilation of bronchi, with chronic sputum production and recurrent respiratory infections.

listings.name: Chronic Pulmonary Hypertension
required_evidence: Cardiac catheterization documenting mean pulmonary artery pressure >= 40 mm Hg
Echocardiogram results
Documentation of severe dyspnea (shortness of breath) on minimal exertion
listings.description: Chronic pulmonary hypertension secondary to chronic pulmonary vascular or parenchymal disease, confirmed by cardiac catheterization.

listings.name: Chronic Heart Failure
required_evidence: Echocardiogram or cardiac catheterization showing systolic or diastolic failure
Documentation of persistent symptoms despite prescribed treatment (shortness of breath, fatigue, edema)
Exercise tolerance test results if available
Cardiology treatment records
listings.description: Chronic heart failure with evidence of systolic or diastolic failure, resulting in inability to perform activities involving moderate exertion.

listings.name: Ischemic Heart Disease
required_evidence: Cardiac catheterization or angiography showing significant coronary artery obstruction
Exercise stress test results showing ischemia at low workload
Documentation of anginal symptoms despite treatment
Cardiology records including surgical/interventional history
listings.description: Ischemic heart disease with chest pain of cardiac origin, demonstrated by exercise testing or imaging, despite prescribed treatment.

listings.name: Recurrent Arrhythmias
required_evidence: ECG or Holter monitor documenting the arrhythmia
Documentation of recurrent episodes of syncope (fainting) or near-syncope despite treatment
Cardiology evaluation records
listings.description: Recurrent arrhythmias, resulting in uncontrolled, documented episodes of syncope or near-syncope, despite adherence to prescribed treatment.

listings.name: Symptomatic Congenital Heart Disease
required_evidence: Cardiac catheterization or echocardiogram documenting the shunt or defect
Documentation of cyanosis or severe exercise limitation
Cardiovascular surgical history
listings.description: Congenital heart disease, documented by appropriate imaging or catheterization, with symptomatic limitations or cyanosis.

listings.name: Chronic Venous Insufficiency
required_evidence: Duplex ultrasound showing venous reflux
Medical documentation of extensive leg swelling or recurrent stasis ulcers
Treatment records showing compression therapy compliance
listings.description: Chronic venous insufficiency of a lower extremity with incompetency or obstruction of the deep venous system, resulting in extensive edema or stasis ulcers.

listings.name: Peripheral Arterial Disease
required_evidence: Doppler studies showing ankle-brachial index (ABI) less than 0.50
Documentation of intermittent claudication with severe impairment
Angiography or vascular surgical records
listings.description: Peripheral arterial disease, with intermittent claudication, and resting ankle/brachial systolic blood pressure ratio less than 0.50.

listings.name: Gastrointestinal Hemorrhaging
required_evidence: Documentation of GI hemorrhaging requiring transfusion of at least 2 units of blood
Evidence of hemorrhaging occurring on 3+ occasions in 6 months, at least 30 days apart
Hospitalization records for each bleeding episode
Gastroenterology treatment records
listings.description: Gastrointestinal hemorrhaging from any cause, requiring blood transfusion of at least 2 units, occurring on 3 or more occasions within a consecutive 6-month period.

listings.name: Chronic Liver Disease
required_evidence: Biopsy or imaging showing cirrhosis or chronic liver disease
Lab results showing elevated bilirubin or low albumin
Documentation of complications like ascites, esophageal varices, or encephalopathy
Gastroenterology or hepatology records
listings.description: Chronic liver disease (including hepatitis, cirrhosis, and liver failure) with complications such as ascites, variceal bleeding, or hepatic encephalopathy.

listings.name: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD)
required_evidence: Endoscopy, imaging, or biopsy confirming IBD diagnosis
Documentation of obstruction, fistula formation, or need for supplemental nutrition
Evidence of 2+ hospitalizations in 6 months or significant weight loss
Gastroenterology treatment records
listings.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis) with obstruction, surgery history, or complications requiring ongoing medical management.

listings.name: Weight Loss due to Digestive Disorder
required_evidence: Calculated Body Mass Index (BMI) of less than 17.50 on at least two evaluations 60+ days apart within a 12-month period
Documentation of the underlying digestive disorder causing the weight loss
listings.description: Weight loss due to any persisting gastrointestinal disorder, resulting in BMI of less than 17.50, documented on at least two evaluations.

listings.name: Nephrotic Syndrome
required_evidence: Lab tests showing severe proteinuria (protein in urine) and low serum albumin
Medical documentation of anasarca (widespread swelling) persisting for 3+ months despite treatment
listings.description: Nephrotic syndrome, with significant proteinuria and severe edema, persisting for at least 3 months despite prescribed treatment.

listings.name: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) Requiring Dialysis
required_evidence: Lab results showing chronic kidney disease (GFR, creatinine levels)
Documentation of dialysis schedule and treatment compliance
OR documentation of kidney transplant
Nephrology treatment records
listings.description: Chronic kidney disease requiring chronic dialysis. Also covered: kidney transplant (considered disabled for 12 months post-transplant).

listings.name: Sickle Cell Disease
required_evidence: Hemoglobin electrophoresis confirming sickle cell disease
Documentation of vaso-occlusive crises requiring parenteral narcotic medication, occurring 3+ times in 12 months
Evidence of complications (stroke, splenic sequestration, chronic anemia)
Hematology treatment records
listings.description: Sickle cell disease with documented painful crises occurring at least 3 times within a 12-month period, requiring parenteral narcotic medications.

listings.name: Coagulation Disorders
required_evidence: Coagulation factor assays showing deficiency
Documentation of spontaneous bleeding episodes requiring transfusion or infusion at least 3 times in 12 months
Hematology treatment records
listings.description: Coagulation disorders (such as hemophilia or Von Willebrand disease), with spontaneous bleeding episodes requiring medical intervention.

listings.name: Bone Marrow Failure
required_evidence: Bone marrow biopsy confirming failure
Documentation of need for lifelong blood or platelet transfusions (at least once every 6 weeks)
Lab reports showing hemoglobin, white count, and platelet count levels
listings.description: Bone marrow failure (including aplastic anemia or myelofibrosis) requiring blood or platelet transfusions at least once every 6 weeks.

listings.name: Dermatitis
required_evidence: Medical documentation of extensive skin lesions persisting for 3+ months despite treatment
Evidence of significant limitation in ability to walk or perform fine/gross movements due to lesions
Dermatologist records
listings.description: Severe dermatitis (including eczema, psoriasis, or seborrhea) with extensive skin lesions that do not respond to treatment and limit physical function.

listings.name: Hidradenitis Suppurativa
required_evidence: Medical records documenting hidradenitis suppurativa lesions in both axillae, both groins, or perineum
Evidence that lesions persist for at least 3 months despite treatment
Dermatology or surgical records
listings.description: Hidradenitis suppurativa with extensive skin lesions in both armpits, both groin areas, or the perineal area, persisting despite treatment.

listings.name: Endocrine Disorders (Diabetes)
required_evidence: Blood glucose monitoring records and HbA1c levels
Documentation of end-organ damage (neuropathy, retinopathy, nephropathy)
Evidence that the condition meets the criteria of another body system listing due to complications
Endocrinologist or primary care treatment records
listings.description: Endocrine disorders are evaluated based on their functional effects on other body systems. Diabetes is assessed by its complications (neuropathy, retinopathy, etc.).

listings.name: Non-Mosaic Down Syndrome
required_evidence: Karyotype analysis confirming non-mosaic Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21)
OR laboratory report with physician confirmation of Trisomy 21
listings.description: Non-mosaic Down Syndrome (Trisomy 21), which is established by clinical findings and compatible genetic testing.

listings.name: Epilepsy — Convulsive / Non-Convulsive
required_evidence: EEG showing epileptiform abnormalities
Detailed description of seizure pattern, frequency, and duration
Medical records showing seizures despite at least 3 months of prescribed treatment
Documentation of postictal manifestations
listings.description: Epilepsy with seizures occurring frequently (at least once a month for tonic-clonic, or once a week for non-convulsive) despite adherence to treatment.

listings.name: Vascular Insult to the Brain (Stroke)
required_evidence: Brain imaging (CT/MRI) showing vascular insult
Documentation of sensory or motor aphasia
Evidence of disorganization of motor function in two extremities
Medical records from treating neurologist
listings.description: Central nervous system vascular accident (stroke) with disorganization of motor function, sensory or motor aphasia, or significant communication deficits.

listings.name: Cerebral Palsy
required_evidence: Medical documentation of cerebral palsy
Evidence of significant difficulty walking, standing, or using hands/arms
OR documentation of severe intellectual or visual impairment
listings.description: Cerebral palsy characterized by significant difficulty walking or using the hands/arms, or severe speech, visual, or intellectual deficits.

listings.name: Multiple Sclerosis
required_evidence: MRI showing characteristic MS lesions
Documentation of disorganization of motor function or visual/mental impairment
Evidence of significant fatigue and weakness requiring rest beyond normal
Neurologist treatment records
listings.description: Multiple sclerosis with disorganization of motor function, visual or mental impairment, or significant reproducible fatigue.

listings.name: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
required_evidence: Neurological documentation of ALS diagnosis (automatically meets disability criteria)
listings.description: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS), also known as Lou Gehrig's disease, which is clinically confirmed and automatically qualifies for disability.

listings.name: Parkinsonian Syndrome
required_evidence: Neurologist documentation of Parkinson's disease
Evidence of significant rigidity, tremors, or bradykinesia in two extremities
Documentation of resulting difficulty walking, standing, or performing manual tasks
listings.description: Parkinsonian syndrome with rigidity, bradykinesia, or tremor, resulting in significant difficulty walking or using the hands/arms.

listings.name: Peripheral Neuropathy
required_evidence: Nerve conduction studies or EMG showing peripheral neuropathy
Documentation of disorganization of motor function in two extremities
Medical records showing limitation in standing, walking, or using hands
Evidence condition persists despite treatment
listings.description: Peripheral neuropathy with disorganization of motor function in two extremities resulting in an extreme limitation of the ability to stand up, balance, walk, or use the upper extremities.

listings.name: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI)
required_evidence: MRI or CT scan showing brain injury
Documentation of motor function loss in two extremities persisting for 3+ months
OR documentation of marked limitation in physical functioning AND mental areas (memory, social, concentration)
listings.description: Traumatic brain injury with disorganization of motor function, or cognitive/behavioral impairments, persisting for at least 3 months.

listings.name: Neurocognitive Disorders (Dementia)
required_evidence: Documentation of significant cognitive decline in memory, language, or executive function
Standardized cognitive testing (e.g. MMSE) results
Evidence of marked limitation in daily living or social functioning
Medical history and psychiatric evaluations
listings.description: Dementia and other neurocognitive disorders characterized by significant decline in one or more cognitive areas, resulting in marked functional limitations.

listings.name: Schizophrenia Spectrum and Other Psychotic Disorders
required_evidence: Psychiatric records documenting delusions, hallucinations, or disorganized thinking/behavior
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two functional areas
OR evidence of serious and persistent disorder (2+ years with marginal adjustment)
Medication and hospitalization records
listings.description: Schizophrenia spectrum and other psychotic disorders characterized by delusions, hallucinations, disorganized thinking, or grossly disorganized behavior.

listings.name: Depressive, Bipolar, and Related Disorders
required_evidence: Psychiatric or psychological treatment records documenting the disorder
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two areas: understanding/remembering/applying information, interacting with others, concentrating/persisting/maintaining pace, or adapting/managing oneself
OR evidence of serious and persistent disorder (2+ years of treatment that diminishes symptoms, with marginal adjustment)
Medication records and therapy notes
listings.description: Depressive, bipolar, and related disorders characterized by medical documentation of depressive syndrome, manic syndrome, or bipolar syndrome, with marked functional limitations.

listings.name: Intellectual Disorder
required_evidence: IQ testing showing significantly subaverage general intellectual functioning (IQ of 70-75 or below)
Documentation of deficits in adaptive functioning initially manifested before age 22
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two functional areas
School records or developmental history if available
listings.description: Intellectual disorder characterized by significantly subaverage general intellectual functioning with deficits in adaptive functioning initially manifested before age 22.

listings.name: Anxiety and Obsessive-Compulsive Disorders
required_evidence: Psychiatric or psychological records documenting the specific anxiety disorder
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two areas: understanding/remembering/applying information, interacting with others, concentrating/persisting/maintaining pace, or adapting/managing oneself
OR evidence the disorder is serious and persistent (2+ years of treatment with marginal adjustment)
Documentation of specific anxiety symptoms (restlessness, fatigue, difficulty concentrating, muscle tension, sleep disturbance)
listings.description: Anxiety and obsessive-compulsive disorders characterized by excessive anxiety, worry, apprehension, or fear, with marked functional limitations.

listings.name: Personality and Impulse-Control Disorders
required_evidence: Clinical documentation of a persistent, inflexible pattern of behavior that causes distress
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two functional areas (social, task completion, adapting)
Psychiatrist/psychologist treatment notes
listings.description: Personality and impulse-control disorders characterized by deeply ingrained, maladaptive patterns of behavior, with marked limitations.

listings.name: Eating Disorders
required_evidence: Documentation of persistent disturbance in eating behavior that significantly alters body weight
Medical records showing BMI below normal or medical complications
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two functional areas
Psychiatric/psychological treatment records
listings.description: Eating disorders with persistent alteration in eating or eating-related behavior that substantially changes body weight, with marked limitation in functioning.

listings.name: Neurodevelopmental Disorders (Autism)
required_evidence: Documentation of qualitative deficits in verbal/nonverbal communication and social interaction
Evidence of significantly restricted, repetitive patterns of behavior
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two functional areas
Diagnostic evaluation from qualified professional
listings.description: Neurodevelopmental disorders characterized by qualitative deficits in verbal communication, nonverbal communication, and social interaction.

listings.name: ADHD / Developmental Disorders
required_evidence: Clinical documentation of hyperactive, impulsive, or inattentive symptoms before age 12
Evidence of marked limitation in learning, social, or executive functioning
Psychiatric or school evaluations
listings.description: Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder characterized by marked inattention, impulsivity, or hyperactivity, resulting in functional limitations.

listings.name: Trauma and Stressor-Related Disorders (PTSD)
required_evidence: Psychiatric records documenting exposure to traumatic event(s)
Evidence of involuntary re-experiencing (flashbacks, nightmares)
Documentation of avoidance, mood/behavioral disturbances
Evidence of marked limitation in at least two functional areas
Treatment history including therapy and/or medication
listings.description: Trauma- and stressor-related disorders characterized by experiencing or witnessing a traumatic event, with involuntary re-experiencing, avoidance, and disturbance in mood and behavior.

listings.name: Malignant Neoplastic Diseases
required_evidence: Pathology report confirming malignancy
Documentation of treatment plan (surgery, chemotherapy, radiation)
Evidence of recurrence, metastasis, or treatment side effects causing functional limitations
Oncology treatment records
listings.description: Malignant neoplastic diseases are evaluated based on the specific type, site, and stage of the cancer, along with response to treatment and residual limitations.

listings.name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
required_evidence: Documentation of involvement of two or more body systems with one at moderate severity
Evidence of repeated manifestations with constitutional symptoms (fatigue, malaise, fever, weight loss)
Medical records showing marked limitation in daily activities, social functioning, or ability to complete tasks
Rheumatology and lab work records (ANA, anti-dsDNA)
listings.description: Systemic lupus erythematosus with involvement of two or more body systems, with repeated manifestations and at least marked limitation in one area of functioning.

listings.name: Systemic Sclerosis (Scleroderma)
required_evidence: Clinical diagnosis of systemic sclerosis with organ involvement
Evidence of repeated manifestations with constitutional symptoms
Documentation of marked limitation in daily activities or task completion
listings.description: Systemic sclerosis (scleroderma) with clinical evidence of systemic involvement of internal organs, or repeated manifestations.

listings.name: Inflammatory Arthritis
required_evidence: Medical documentation of inflammatory arthritis with persistent joint inflammation
Imaging showing joint destruction or deformity
Evidence of involvement of major peripheral joints or spinal joints with inability to ambulate effectively or perform fine/gross movements
Rheumatology treatment records
listings.description: Inflammatory arthritis with persistent inflammation or deformity in major peripheral joints or joints of the spine, resulting in inability to ambulate effectively or perform fine and gross movements.

listings.name: HIV/AIDS
required_evidence: Documentation of HIV infection
Evidence of opportunistic infection, malignancy, or other manifestation
OR evidence of repeated manifestations with marked limitation in activities of daily living, social functioning, or completing tasks
Infectious disease and lab records (CD4 count, viral load)
listings.description: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection with specified manifestations or repeated manifestations resulting in significant functional limitations.
